notifications.install: On iPhone notifications only arrive with arga installed: in Safari, Share → Add to Home Screen, and come back here from the icon.

notifications.test.nowhere: It did not reach any device.

settings.claude.hint: Connect your own Claude to your arga account. Whatever Claude looks up or does, it does with your data and only yours.
settings.claude.revoke: , and take Claude's access away whenever you want.
settings.claude.sessions: See your sessions and the access you have given
settings.claude.step1: In Claude, open Settings → Hub and add a custom connector.
settings.claude.step2: Paste the server URL. In the advanced options, set the client ID and leave the secret empty.
settings.claude.step3: Press Connect and sign in with your Google account.
settings.glass.hint: The effect is immediate and travels to your other devices.
settings.glass.opaque: At the maximum the bar is opaque and the blur turns off completely.
settings.glass.title: Transparency
settings.home.hint: Each panel that is on is a home page, in this order and before the widget pages. You can also add and remove them by editing the home.
settings.icons.hint: The app installed on your phone always uses the colour one: the system sets it when installing.
settings.names.hint: It is the name they show in Modules. Inside each app the usual one stays.
settings.versions.hint: Each app is deployed on its own: its numbers need not match arga's.
spaces.alone: You are the only person in the space, so you cannot leave: it would be left with nobody.
spaces.error.retry: It could not be done. Try again in a moment.
spaces.failed: Your spaces could not be loaded.
spaces.hint: A space is a group of people who see the same things, like the household shopping list. You join with a code you hand out: nobody can find you without it.
spaces.invite.hint: It works once and expires in 48 hours. Give it to whoever you want to let in.
spaces.leave.consequence: You will stop seeing what is in the space, including what was there before. The others keep it. To come back they will have to invite you.
spaces.leave.title: Leave {space}?
spaces.name: Space name
spaces.name.hint: Only the people in this space see it. It can be different in each one.
spaces.remove.consequence: They will stop seeing what is in the space, including what was there before. To come back you will have to invite them.
spaces.remove.title: Remove {name}?
spaces.title: Spaces
starting.confirm.desktop: It replaces the computer's pages and widgets with the starting ones. What you have placed on the computer now cannot be recovered; the other device does not change.
starting.confirm.mobile: It replaces the phone's pages and widgets with the starting ones. What you have placed on the phone now cannot be recovered; the other device does not change.
starting.failed: It could not be changed. Try again in a moment.
starting.hint: The starting one has four pages: Today (agenda, tasks and Claude usage), Health, Money and More. It is different on the phone and on the computer.
starting.title: Desktop
wallpaper.delete.consequence: The image you uploaded is deleted. If it was in use, the default wallpaper comes back. This cannot be undone.
wallpaper.delete.title: Delete this wallpaper?
wallpaper.failed: The image could not be uploaded. Try again.
wallpaper.focus: Point kept in view: {x}% from the left and {y}% from the top. Tap or use the arrows to move it.
wallpaper.focus.hint: Tap what you want to see when the screen crops the photo.
wallpaper.hint: This is the desktop one. Each app can have its own: you choose it in its Settings.
wallpaper.offline: It did not upload: there seems to be no connection. Try again.
wallpaper.rejected: This image could not be used: {detail}.
wallpaper.scrim: The system darkens or lightens the photo just enough for what sits on top to be readable: on this one, up to {light}% in light mode and {dark}% in dark mode, and less in the centre.
wallpaper.title: Wallpaper
